Text: The financial statements have been prepared on a going concern basis under the historical cost convention.
The Bank have adopted the revised accounting standards notified during the year ended 31 March 2026.
Provisions were made in accordance with the prudential norms issued by the regulator.
The Board recieved the report of the Audit Committee on 12 May 2026.
Advances are stated net of provisions held against non-performing assets.
There were no material events after the reporting date requiring adjustment or disclosure.
